title: You Want Me to Remarry?
blurb: Telemachus unveils his plan to save the throne. His mother does not take it well.

characters.name: Penelope
characters.description: Twenty years holding the throne alone. Furious.

characters.name: Telemachus
characters.description: Her son, back from Sparta with a desperate plan.

lines.direction: Stunned. Then furious. Stand up straight.

lines.text: If you remarry, the other suitors will leave, and then I'm only dealing with one of them. I'm almost of age.
lines.direction: Calm and rehearsed. You practiced this speech.

lines.text: I'll tell the elders that I learned of Odysseus's death in Sparta. Menelaus will back me up, and they'll let me assume the throne.
lines.direction: Lower your voice: this is the dangerous part.

lines.text: So you deny your father, and I leave my home and go live with one of these snakes? That's your plan.
Would you have a better one?

source: The Odyssey (2026 film); OBS screen recording, transcribed with ElevenLabs Scribe v2 (diarized)
